title: Chapter 394 The Beacon Tower Was Lit
content:
Chapter 394 The Beacon Tower Was Lit

Wang Shuo immediately climbed up, swallowed a drop of water of life, and took advantage of the crocodile man's injury to start a combo.

First, control, then a move of "dragon out of the sea".

Then another move of "transformation into a dragon".

These two moves directly made the crocodile man vomit blood again.

Ayub also reacted and performed "breaking the sky".

The crocodile man was hit hard again.

But he was not killed on the spot.

He also took out a pill, put it in his mouth, and then jumped off the wall and ran away.

Wang Shuo wanted to chase him, but he didn't dare to jump down.

After all, there were dense monsters below, and he would definitely die if he went down.

Just when Wang Shuo was about to breathe a sigh of relief.

Wang Shuo found that a beacon tower was lit in the distance.

Wang Shuo's heart tightened, this was a fatal matter.

The beacon tower was lit, which meant that a section of the wall was lost.

Wang Shuo immediately ordered the reserve to go up to the wall.

Then he took one-third of the generals to support.

Although the wall where the beacon tower was lit was not the one he was defending, everyone was a whole. If others failed to defend it, it would be useless for him to defend it alone.

The Sixth Army was the one who lit the beacon tower.

Wang Shuo remembered that a general from Nanxuan Prefecture was responsible for it.

Wang Shuo was a little annoyed and wanted to scold his teammates.

But when he rushed over, he was stunned.

Because there were 10 monsters on the wall, all of them were platinum bosses.

It was equivalent to 10 primary generals.

Wang Shuo's brain was buzzing.

There was no way to resist this force.

Just as Wang Shuo arrived, Zhu Dongheng, the governor of Nanxuan Prefecture, also rushed over.

Seeing the 10 generals, he also took a breath.

Until now, Wang Shuo still didn't know how many generals there were on the monster side.

Zhu Dongheng was a mid-level general like Zhao Bangde.

Wang Shuo didn't have confidence either. He didn't know if he could resist it. Even if he added himself, it felt a little shaky.

There was no other way, Wang Shuo only had the strength to fight one alone.

Gong Zheng and Ayub had no choice but to bite the bullet and take on one.

The one fighting against Wang Shuo was a tiger boss.

Wang Shuo used a move called "Dragon Strike".

Unexpectedly, he injured it, and Wang Shuo was surprised.

His attack should not be so powerful!

After fighting for a few more rounds, Wang Shuo found that this tiger boss was still much worse than the crocodile man.

Although the attack was fierce, the defense was not good, and Wang Shuo's ordinary attacks could cause damage to it.

Unlike the crocodile man, ordinary attacks could not break the defense at all.

Thinking of this, Wang Shuo felt it was reasonable!

The crocodile man should be able to serve as a small commander of an offensive force because of his strong defense and high combat power.

And these ordinary general-level bosses, Wang Shuo should still be able to beat.

Wang Shuo took a look at Zhu Dongheng, who actually summoned 3 puppets.

Each of them had the strength of a general, and he held back four bosses without falling into a disadvantage.

Wang Shuo now had a deeper understanding of the intermediate generals.

No wonder he couldn't even block a casual punch from Zhao Bangde.

Facing a powerful enemy, Wang Shuo didn't care about much and fought desperately. As long as it didn't cause fatal damage to himself, he didn't defend himself and relied on the water of life to survive.

With his injury-for-injury fighting style, after a few rounds, the tiger boss on the opposite side was killed by him.

Wang Shuo had developed a habit in the general tower. After killing the monster, he liked to split the head with a shot.

Sure enough, a demon pill was found in the head of the tiger boss.

After putting away the demon pill, Wang Shuo immediately dealt with the boss that Gong Zheng and others were entangled with.

Seeing that the situation in this place began to stabilize.

At this time, another place lit a beacon tower.
